premise: Pilot plays traffic warden with his glowing wands as the shuttle, a satellite and an asteroid all cross the sky at once — and the asteroid, as usual, listens to nobody.
inspiration: Grimm's 'Town Musicians of Bremen' (travellers all on one road), turned: they all pass by, and the one who won't wait goes first.
lesson: Sometimes the kindest rule is to let someone go first.

en-US.title: The Busiest Sky
en-US.text: {pilot:enter} {pilot:face surprised} Pilot looked up. The sky was getting busy. {shuttle:enter} The shuttle was gliding one way. {satellite:enter} A satellite was drifting the other. And right through the middle, tumbling like a lost potato, came an {asteroid:enter} asteroid. [excited] This calls for a traffic warden! {pilot:live hold} Pilot crossed his glowing wands up high: STOP! {shuttle:live} The shuttle opened its doors and waited politely. {satellite:live} The satellite blinked: waiting. {asteroid:live} The asteroid just kept tumbling. Asteroids don't listen to anybody. {robodog:enter} {robodog:face surprised} Robo-dog beeped at it. {pilot:live resume} {pilot:face happy} [laughs] Fine, said Pilot. Rocks first! {asteroid:go away right} Off it tumbled. Then {shuttle:go away left} the shuttle, {satellite:go away right} then the satellite. {pilot:hop} Pilot took a bow. Really, they had been thousands of miles apart. {robodog:hop} [giggles] But it was a very good job.

es-ES.title: El cielo más concurrido
es-ES.text: {pilot:enter} {pilot:face surprised} Piloto miró arriba. El cielo se estaba llenando. {shuttle:enter} El transbordador iba hacia un lado. {satellite:enter} Un satélite flotaba hacia el otro. Y justo por el medio, dando tumbos como una patata perdida, llegaba un {asteroid:enter} asteroide. [excited] ¡Esto necesita un guardia de tráfico! {pilot:live hold} Piloto cruzó sus bastones luminosos bien alto: ¡ALTO! {shuttle:live} El transbordador abrió sus puertas y esperó con educación. {satellite:live} El satélite parpadeó: esperando. {asteroid:live} El asteroide siguió dando tumbos. Los asteroides no hacen caso a nadie. {robodog:enter} {robodog:face surprised} Perro robot le pitó. {pilot:live resume} {pilot:face happy} [laughs] Vale, dijo Piloto. ¡Primero las rocas! {asteroid:go away right} Allá se fue, rodando. Luego {shuttle:go away left} el transbordador, {satellite:go away right} y luego el satélite. {pilot:hop} Piloto hizo una reverencia. En realidad, estaban a miles de kilómetros unos de otros. {robodog:hop} [giggles] Pero había sido un trabajo estupendo.
